patches.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches.description: Neutralizes Google AppMeasurement, Firebase Crashlytics, Branch attribution, and Adobe Creative SDK analytics dispatchers, redirects Adobe Edge and DTM endpoints to 0.0.0.0, strips advertising permissions, and injects analytics opt-out flags.

patches.name: Sideload Install Support
patches.description: Ensures compatibility for sideloaded lab installs by allowing local installer source checks to report success and completing Play Integrity token requests. Required for sideloaded lab installs: without it the app routes to the Play Store.

patches.name: Unlock Premium Features
patches.description: Enables app features locked behind subscription paywalls by activating the internal Limited-Time Premium Unlock (LTPU) gate. Requires Sideload Install Support (applied automatically as dependency).

patches.name: Block Trackers
patches.description: Blocks crash reporting, ad attribution and referral tracking.

patches.name: Remove Extra Files
patches.description: Deletes tutorial videos, editor stickers and junk to shrink the app.

patches.name: Stop Background Sync
patches.description: Stops background sync tasks and alarms that drain the battery.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks Pro features stored on the device (routines, folders, charts). Server-limited items may still need a subscription.

patches.name: AR Effects Slimmer
patches.description: Strips ARCore native binaries (libarcore_sdk_c.so, libarcore_sdk_jni.so) and AR effect/face tracking asset models. WARNING: Disables camera AR filters, 3D face effects, and body/face tracking.

patches.name: Block Crash & Diagnostics
patches.description: Neutralizes crash-dump uploaders, Lacrima detector broadcasts, debug diagnostics, carrier preload trackers, and lead-ads entrypoints.

patches.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches.description: Neutralizes Facebook Analytics2, DataTransport, FDID/PhoneId providers, and strips AD_ID permissions.

patches.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches.description: Neutralizes Google AppMeasurement, AppsFlyer, and ByteDance AppLog event dispatchers.

patches.name: Bypass Effects Region Restriction
patches.description: Fixes effects, transitions, and templates failing to load (ByteDance Shark WAF block) by spoofing device_platform to 'windows' and resetting deviceId in effect requests.

patches.name: Bypass GeoBlock Region Restriction
patches.description: Forces CapCut GeoBlock config lists (cert, dock, entrance, page, scheme) to empty so region-blocked surfaces stay enabled. Server-refused content may still fail to load.

patches.name: Bypass Signature Check
patches.description: Spoofs the official APK signature (SHA-256) for tamper telemetry, drops the server-driven signature blacklist, silences the abnormal-source toast, and disables the Godzilla inject-detect gate so re-signed builds are not blocked.

patches.name: Bypass Unsafe Package Modal
patches.description: Replaces the unsafe-package modal fallback URL in the Lynx schema defaults with the real template portal URL so region-blocked or untrusted-client fallbacks open templates instead of the blocking security notice.

patches.name: Locale Assets Slimmer
patches.description: Strips unselected CapCut asset locale bundles (assets/locales/*.json) from the APK. English is always preserved. For res/values-* string tables use the canonical universal Remove Extra Languages patch.

options.description: Comma-separated language codes to preserve (e.g. 'en, es, pt, fr, de'). Base fallback and English are always retained.

patches.name: Native Bloat Slimmer
patches.description: Strips non-essential companion native libraries by zeroing bytes in-situ. Always zeroes AppLovin ad crash reporter. WARNING: Stripping speech recognition and synthesis engines (libspeech*.so) disables voice recognition, voiceover captions, and speech-to-text features.

options.description: WARNING: Stripping speech recognition and synthesis engines (libspeechengine.so, libspeechepg.so, libspeechsdk.so) breaks voice effects, text-to-speech, and automatic captions.

patches.name: Remove Watermark
patches.description: Forces CapCut watermark-removal gates to allow export without watermark (WatermarkBusinessFunction).

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Forces CapCut VIP gates to return true (SubscribeImpl, PayVipImpl, UserVipInfo, UserDetailInfo, VipUserServiceImpl, SubscribeCloudImpl) plus central account status flags (BusinessManager). Cloud-gated assets may still fail.

patches.name: Unlock Premium Templates
patches.description: Marks premium template styles as available so locked template features stay usable.

patches.name: Unlock Ultra HD Export
patches.description: Forces CapCut Ultra HD / high-resolution export gates to unlocked so 4K export options stay available.

patches.name: Block Trackers
patches.description: Stops analytics and usage reporting.

patches.name: Device Privacy Guard
patches.description: Hides hardware IDs and lets Bluetooth work without location.

patches.name: Offline Only
patches.description: Fully disconnects the app from the internet. Pair your earbuds first.

patches.name: Run on Rooted Devices
patches.description: Lets the app run on rooted phones and network tools without crashing.

patches.name: Safer Connections
patches.description: Blocks unencrypted traffic and disables certificate pinning.

patches.name: Show All Models
patches.description: Shows every earbud model for pairing.

patches.name: Skip Popups & Tutorials
patches.description: Skips startup agreements, tutorials, and promo banners.

patches.name: Stop Background Activity
patches.description: Stops persistent notifications and background battery drain.

patches.name: Unlock Sound Features
patches.description: Enables spatial audio and hearing features on all devices.

patches.name: Unlock for Other Phones
patches.description: Enables full features on Samsung, Pixel, and other non-Xiaomi phones.

patches.name: Update Without Account
patches.description: Lets guests check and install earbud firmware updates.

patches.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches.description: Neutralizes Microsoft OneDS/Aria lifecycle, aggregated-metric and failure-logging dispatch methods, nullifies ad measurement platform identifiers (AIFA, AppSetId), rewrites default telemetry endpoints inside telemetry packages and custom blocked hosts unscoped to 0.0.0.0, disables cross-sell, Floodgate, HockeyApp and DataTransport components, and strips advertising permissions.

options.description: Comma-separated list of additional telemetry hostnames or domains to redirect to 0.0.0.0. Single-label, credentialed-URL, and IPv6 entries are skipped.

patches.name: Bypass Code Transparency
patches.description: Skips the code-transparency failure dialog and reports local verification success, unblocking sideloaded installs.

patches.name: Copilot Companion Native Slimmer
patches.description: Strips optional companion native binaries (React Native, Hermes, SlimCV) via in-situ zeroing. WARNING: Hermes and React Native are load-bearing for React Native initialization - enabling this WILL crash Copilot React Native surfaces (Copilot chat host) with UnsatisfiedLinkError. The HockeyApp native exception handler (proven UnsatisfiedLinkError in OfficeApplication.onMAMCreate) and voice/dictation SDKs (libofficevoicesdk, libofficevoicetranscriptionsdk; proven dlopen FATAL on boot path) are load-bearing at startup and are therefore never stripped.

patches.name: Disable Login Requirement
patches.description: Removes login requirement and FTUX paywall screens. Cloud-backed features still require sign-in server-side.

patches.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches.description: Neutralizes Microsoft OneDS/Aria lifecycle, aggregated-metric and failure-logging dispatch methods, nullifies ad measurement platform identifiers (AIFA, AppSetId), disables HockeyApp activities and DataTransport components, and strips advertising permissions.

patches.name: Bypass Code Transparency
patches.description: Bypasses the code transparency checks.

patches.name: Disable Login Requirement
patches.description: Removes login requirement and FTUX paywall screens.

patches.name: PowerPoint Companion Native Slimmer
patches.description: Strips optional companion native binaries (React Native and Hermes JavaScript runtime stack) via in-situ zeroing. WARNING: stripped libraries are load-bearing for React Native initialization - enabling this WILL crash the app with UnsatisfiedLinkError when Copilot or other React Native surfaces start, not merely hide those features.

patches.name: Remove Shared User ID
patches.description: Removes the sharedUserId attribute from the manifest to prevent installation conflicts.

patches.name: Unlock 365 Family
patches.description: Unlocks Microsoft 365 Family subscription features locally.

patches.name: Block Ads
patches.description: Blocks ad loaders and unlocks ad-free status.

patches.name: Block Trackers
patches.description: Blocks analytics and ad tracking.

patches.name: Remove Extra Files
patches.description: Deletes hidden ad files and trackers to shrink the app.

patches.name: Remove Extra Stores
patches.description: Disables payment components for other app stores you do not use.

patches.name: Safer Connections
patches.description: Uses trusted certificates while keeping printer downloads working.

patches.name: Skip Welcome Screen
patches.description: Skips the first-launch popup (the About menu still works).

patches.name: Stop Background Sync
patches.description: Stops background tasks that drain the battery.

patches.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches.description: Neutralizes AppsFlyer, Braze, and Inneractive DEX dispatchers, disables analytics services/providers, and strips advertising permissions.

patches.name: Fix Google Maps
patches.description: Restores Google Maps rendering by spoofing the original package signature to Google Play Services.

options.description: Optional custom Google Maps Platform key. When omitted, built-in keys work automatically via signature spoofing.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Hides banner and inline ads and neutralizes ad unit ID lookups.

patches.name: Suppress Paywalls
patches.description: Suppresses subscription paywalls, onboarding upgrade dialogs, and promotional cards.

patches.name: Unlock Moovit+
patches.description: Unlocks Moovit+ premium subscription features locally, including Safe Ride and address search in favorites.

patches.name: Background Slimmer
patches.description: Disables background periodic jobs, home screen widgets, and companion services to reduce resource usage.

patches.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches.description: Blocks tracking services, analytics collection, and advertising identifiers, redirects Braze and Sentry endpoints to 0.0.0.0, and purges Sentry manifest metadata.

options.description: Redirects Plaid, ScribeUp, and financial anti-fraud telemetry endpoints to 0.0.0.0. WARNING: Enabling this disables X Payments and banking verification features.

patches.name: Block Update Screen
patches.description: Blocks the outdated app screen and suppresses in-app update prompts on launch.

patches.name: Control Video Auto Scroll
patches.description: Prevents automatic scrolling to the next video in immersive view.

patches.name: Custom Deep Links
patches.description: Opens supported custom and alternative domain links directly in the app (for shared link domains, see Share Links).

options.description: Custom domains to register for opening directly in the app.

patches.name: Custom Fonts
patches.description: Applies custom typography to post and profile text.

options.description: Absolute device path to a TTF font applied to post and profile text, e.g. /sdcard/fonts/myfont.ttf.
Absolute device path to a TTF font applied to emojis, e.g. /sdcard/fonts/myemojifont.ttf.

patches.name: DM Debloat
patches.description: Hides call buttons and composer actions in direct message conversations.

options.description: Hide audio and video call buttons in direct message conversations (warning: disables outgoing direct message calls).

patches.name: Default Reply Sorting
patches.description: Opens replies on every post with the selected sort mode instead of Relevance.

options.description: Sort mode replies open with on every post.

patches.name: Disable Auto Refresh
patches.description: Stops the home timeline from automatically jumping to new posts.

patches.name: Drawer Items
patches.description: Hides individual menu items, badges, and sidebar entries in the navigation drawer.

Hide Premium subscription entry and discount badges in navigation drawer (for profile and home upsells, see Remove Premium Upsell).

Hide Grok Imagine action button on profile header banner (for Grok drawer and navigation tab, see Drawer Items and Navigation UI).

options.description: Hide Get Verified subscription pill on user profiles (for drawer Premium entry, see Drawer Items).

patches.name: Round Off Numbers
patches.description: Displays full metric counts without abbreviation on posts and profiles.

options.description: Show full numbers without abbreviation instead of rounded values (e.g. 1,234 instead of 1.2K).

patches.name: Share Links
patches.description: Customizes domain and format for shared post links (for opening custom links in app, see Custom Deep Links).

options.description: Replace x.com with the selected custom domain when sharing post links.
Domain replacing x.com when sharing post links, e.g. https://fxtwitter.com.
Include post author username in shared links instead of the modern generic status format.

patches.name: Show Sensitive Media
patches.description: Displays sensitive media directly without requiring tap to reveal.

patches.description: Customizes timeline surfaces including banners, recommendation carousels, and action buttons.

Hide promote button under self posts.

Hide live and broadcast pill at top of home timeline.

patches.name: Unlock Video Downloads
patches.description: Lets you save videos and GIFs with the app's built-in download option without Premium.
